description: This Python script is designed to merge multiple runtime manifests into a single combined manifest for a web application that uses Gunicorn. It reads two JSON manifest files, merges their contents with specific rules, and writes out a combined manifest, including runtime metadata. The script also includes a command-line interface for easy execution.
